name: CrashX frozen-visual temporal grounding proof of concept v1
split_requirement: Use only a frozen source-grouped split; the current provisional split is diagnostic only.

objective.target: discrete start and end positions over 16 uniformly sampled frames

pre_registered_methods: train mean and median time windows

counterfactual_tests.temporal_circular_shift: Shift visual features by a fixed number of frame positions and test whether predicted event positions shift consistently.
counterfactual_tests.event_frame_removal: Replace predicted/annotated event-region features with context features and measure localization degradation.
counterfactual_tests.non_event_frame_removal: Apply an equal-size control removal outside the event region.

claim_gate: Claim visual temporal grounding only if the visual head beats all position/prior controls on the frozen test split and passes both counterfactual sensitivity tests.
